import logging
import os

import requests
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException

from app.auth import require_user
from app.services import invoices

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
router = APIRouter()
TAX_API_KEY = os.environ["TAX_API_KEY"]


@router.post("/invoices")
def create_invoice(customer_id: int, amount_cents: int, user=Depends(require_user)):
    try:
        response = requests.get(
            "https://tax.example.com/v1/rate",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {TAX_API_KEY}"},
            timeout=5,
        )
        response.raise_for_status()
    except requests.RequestException as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail="Tax service unavailable") from exc
    rate = response.json()["rate"]
    invoice = invoices.create(customer_id, amount_cents, rate)
    logger.info("Created invoice %s", invoice.id)
    return invoice
